text: Api breaking change: removed the `/api/organizations/:organizationId/documents/search` endpoint in favor of the existing `/api/organizations/:organizationId/documents` with an optional `searchQuery` query parameter. The new `/api/organizations/:organizationId/documents` endpoint now behave as the old `/search` endpoint, with all documents being returned when `searchQuery` is empty. Note that the response field `totalCount` of the old `/search` endpoint has been renamed to `documentsCount` in the new endpoint. Before: ``` GET /api/organizations/:organizationId/documents/search?searchQuery=invoice&pageIndex=1&pageSize=20 Response: { documents: Document[]; totalCount: number; } GET /api/organizations/:organizationId/documents?pageIndex=1&pageSize=20 Response: { documents: Document[]; documentsCount: number; } ``` After: ``` GET /api/organizations/:organizationId/documents?searchQuery=invoice&pageIndex=1&pageSize=20 Response: { documents: Document[]; documentsCount: number; } ```

author: CorentinTh
text: **Breaking change regarding webhook URLs** Added SSRF protection for webhook URLs. Webhook URLs are now validated to ensure they do not point to private or reserved IP addresses, preventing potential server-side request forgery attacks. So webhooks pointing to private IPs (e.g. `http://192.168.0.1/some/stuff`), or with domains resolving to private IPs (e.g. `http://myservice.local/some/stuff`) will be blocked unless explicitly allowed. Two new configuration options are available: - `WEBHOOK_SSRF_PROTECTION_ENABLED` Set to `false` to fully disable SSRF protection. This is not recommended, prefer using the allowlist below instead. - `WEBHOOK_URL_ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES` A comma-separated list of hostnames (IP addresses or domain names) that are explicitly trusted and exempt from SSRF checks (e.g. internal services you control). Addressing [GHSA-cjw7-qg95-58mq](https://github.com/papra-hq/papra/security/advisories/GHSA-cjw7-qg95-58mq), credit to [@Toothless5143](https://github.com/Toothless5143) for the responsible disclosure.

text: Added content preview for yaml files

author: CorentinTh
text: Html-ish characters in email templates are now escaped instead of sanitized-out

author: CorentinTh
text: Increased default max file size from 10MB to 25MB (can still be customized using `DOCUMENT_STORAGE_MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE`, disable by setting it to 0).

author: mvlanga
text: Added a download file option in document list action menu

author: CorentinTh
text: Add batch document trash API endpoint.

author: CorentinTh
text: Limited search query to 1024 characters

author: CorentinTh
text: Fixed an authorization issue where tag updates and deletions were not scoped to the organization in the URL. Tag mutation endpoints are now correctly scoped to the requested organization. Addressing [GHSA-wrx4-3vff-jm94](https://github.com/papra-hq/papra/security/advisories/GHSA-wrx4-3vff-jm94), credit to [@TinkAnet](https://github.com/TinkAnet) for the responsible disclosure.

author: CorentinTh
text: Tag deletion endpoint now returns a `204 No Content` status code instead of `200 OK` with an empty JSON object, and a `404 Not Found` status code is returned when trying to delete a tag that does not exists for the organization.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added batch selection in the document page, allowing to select multiple documents (or all matching the current search) and either manage tags or delete them in one go.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added a batch document tag management API endpoint.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added `sortField` and `sortOrder` query parameters to the document list/search endpoint (`GET /api/organizations/:organizationId/documents`), allowing documents to be sorted by `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, `name`, or `documentDate` in ascending or descending order.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added sorting option in the documents list, allowing to sort documents by name, or creation date, in ascending or descending order.

author: CorentinTh
text: The documents page content now uses the whole width of the page

author: CorentinTh
text: Updated some critical dependencies (better-auth, drizzle-orm, hono, ...) to fix transitive vulnerabilities. Please do not hesitate to report any regression you may encounter, especially if it is related to authentication or database access. Thanks!

author: CorentinTh
text: Switched docker image pnpm installation from corepack to npm global installation, as Node.js 26 image no longer ships corepack.

author: CorentinTh
text: Updated to Node.js 26

author: CorentinTh
text: Updated pnpm to v11

author: CorentinTh
text: Webhooks no longer follow http redirects (3xx responses) when sending requests. Addressing [GHSA-5g86-85rp-f9hx](https://github.com/papra-hq/papra/security/advisories/GHSA-5g86-85rp-f9hx), credit to [@FredrikEV](https://github.com/FredrikEV) for the responsible disclosure.

author: CorentinTh
text: Webhooks ssrf validation is now enforced when sending webhook requests, preventing potential TOCTOU dns rebinding attacks (the exploitation window was very small and only theoretical though).

author: CorentinTh
text: Export the http client type.

author: CorentinTh
text: Fixed a regression issue breaking the two factor authentication after updating `better-auth`.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added the possibility to delete a user in the admin user details page.

author: CorentinTh
text: Fix admin layout pushing the sidenav out of view when page content is long.

author: magic0whi
text: Fix preview of pdfs without embedded fonts by packaging cmaps and custom fonts in the app assets. Increasing the bundle size by ~2mb, but it's worth it for the improved UX and compatibility with a wider range of pdfs.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added the possibility to disable the initial startup execution of all scheduled tasks by setting the `RUN_SCHEDULED_TASKS_ON_STARTUP_DEFAULT=false` environment variable, mainly usefull for instance that reboot often, dev environments or fast startup requirements (few ms gained). Each task startup configuration remain individually configurable with their dedicated environment variable.

author: anbraten
text: Added the ability to save search queries as views, allowing quick access to frequently used searches. Saved views can be accessed from the sidebar.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added document sharing by link: generate a public link to share a document with anyone, without requiring a Papra account. Links can optionally be password-protected and given an expiration date, can be disabled/re-enabled, and are all manageable from a new organization-level "Share links" page.

author: CorentinTh
text: Laid out the base for the rate limit system.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added the possibility to add notes to documents, which can be used to add additional information or context to a document.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added api-key permissions for managing custom properties

author: CorentinTh
text: Custom property definition deletion endpoint (`DELETE /api/organizations/:organizationId/custom-properties/:propertyDefinitionId`) now returns a 204 with no body instead of a 200 with an empty object.

author: CorentinTh
text: Fix the document preview being shrunk by very long document name not containing common break characters (spaces, dashes, ...)

author: CorentinTh
text: Fix the displayed max organization count on the user admin page

author: CorentinTh
text: Set S3 checksum verification headers to "when required" to fix Backblaze B2 storage issues.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added the possibility to configure the file size polling interval for ingestion folder watchers. - `INGESTION_FOLDER_WATCHER_FILE_STABILITY_THRESHOLD_MS`: The amount of time in milliseconds for a file size to remain constant before being consumed. This helps to avoid processing files that are still being written to (e.g., scanners, cameras, network shares, etc.). - `INGESTION_FOLDER_WATCHER_FILE_STABILITY_POLL_INTERVAL_MS`: The interval in milliseconds at which the file size is polled while waiting for write to finish.

author: CorentinTh
text: Replace the AWS S3 SDK (`@aws-sdk/client-s3` + `@aws-sdk/lib-storage`) with the zero-dependency `s3mini` for document S3 storage. This removes 97 transitive packages (~23 MB unpacked) from the server, replacing them with a single more performant and dependency-free package.

author: CorentinTh
text: Updated tesseract.js to v7 which should increase extraction performance by 15 to 35% on images, [source](https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js/releases/tag/v7.0.0).

author: Pallavikumarimdb
text: Sort documents by document date instead of the created date.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added missing translations in all non-English languages.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added AI auto-tagging. When document content is extracted, it can now be automatically tagged using AI. The system uses tag names and descriptions to determine the most relevant tags for the document, and can optionally create new tags if they don't already exist.

author: CorentinTh
text: Auto tagging can be configured per organization, with a dedicated page in organization settings. Owners can manage the following settings: - Enable or disable auto tagging for their organization. - Enable the creation of new tags if relevant tags do not exist. - Configure the maximum number of tags that can be automatically added to a document.

author: CorentinTh
text: Pined the Dockerfile node version sha to reduce supply chain attack surface.

author: CorentinTh
text: Make the top navigation bar mobile-friendly: the search, import, and admin buttons now collapse to icon-only on small screens, and the user settings dropdown is now available on mobile devices.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added mobile friendly hamburger menu in organization settings.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added mobile friendly hamburger menu in account settings.

author: CorentinTh
text: Extracted and translated remaining hard coded texts, improving localization for non-English languages.

author: CorentinTh
text: Excluded sourcemaps from package bundle

author: CorentinTh
text: Add support for external document content extraction/ocr, with multiple provider, and support for combining providers using document type filtering and fallback. Currently supported providers are: - Mistral OCR - Azure Document Intelligence - Docling server - Custom HTTP endpoint (configurable) - Internal Papra extraction engine (default)

author: CorentinTh
text: Document sort order fallback to the importation date when the sort order is set to other sort orders.

author: CorentinTh
text: Fixed the inline tag picker lowercasing the typed name when suggesting a new tag, so newly created tags now keep their original casing (e.g. typing "Invoices" no longer suggests "invoices").

author: CorentinTh
text: Greatly improved the performances when updating and deleting document from the sezarch index, avoiding unnecessary table scans. Noticeable improvement on large document collections (10k+ documents).

author: CorentinTh
text: Added visual loading state to the rename document modal.

author: CorentinTh
text: Fix the coercion of `AUTO_TAGGING_DEFAULT_MAX_TAGS` that caused a validation error when the value is a string instead of a number. Now correctly converts the string to a number, preventing the validation error.

author: CorentinTh
text: Fix auto tagging schema definition for some ai providers (notably OpenAI and Anthropic), as they do not support all JSON schema features. It's really nice to have a common spec, if only all providers respected it...

author: CorentinTh
text: Added better logging when an error occurs during the structured data generation.

author: CorentinTh
text: Collapse the mobile menu sheet when navigating to a new page.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added some database indexes for better performances.

author: CorentinTh
text: Security fix: document share links belonging to a soft-deleted organization were still publicly accessible. Public access (document metadata, file download, and password verification) now stops with a 410 Gone as soon as the organization is deleted, and resumes automatically if the organization is restored during the grace period. Thank you to [Thammachart Sittharod](https://github.com/penthammachat-creator) for the responsible disclosure of this issue.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added a skeleton loader in the sidenav organization picker when fetching organizations

author: CorentinTh
text: Fix mistral ocr replacing tables with external references, no more `[tbl-0.md](tbl-0.md)` in extracted content, the tables are now properly extracted and included in the content.

author: CorentinTh
text: Increased and made configurable the timeout of content extraction external service. Docling, Mistral OCR, and Azure DI can now take up to 5 minutes to process a document, instead of the previous 30 seconds, configurable via `DOCLING_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS`, `MISTRAL_OCR_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS` and `AZURE_DI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS` respectively.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added Catalan language

author: CorentinTh
text: Security fix: revoke all user sessions on password reset. Thank you to [MMartinez](https://github.com/murillomr) for the responsible disclosure of this issue.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added a deletion confirmation modal when deleting a tagging rule, to prevent accidental deletion of tagging rules.

author: ybizeul
text: Fix PDF content preview rendering issue after navigation

author: qmarlats
text: Fixed the batch document selection remaining in "select all matching documents" mode after unselecting documents.

author: CorentinTh
text: Prevent stripe webhook forgery for apps with unconfigured webhooks secrets. Thank you to [Andrew Gonzalez](https://www.linkedin.com/in/andrew-gonzalez-6b8b68257/) ([@bruhdev1290](https://github.com/bruhdev1290)) for the responsible disclosure of this issue.

author: sp71
text: Include the tag name in the tag deletion confirmation message.

author: CorentinTh
text: Fixed an issue where setting `AUTH_IS_REGISTRATION_ENABLED=false` hid the sign-up interface but did not block email and password registrations made directly through the authentication API.

author: CorentinTh
text: Verify server initial ping response body to avoid interpreting 2xx responses that may be an auth proxy redirection.

author: CorentinTh
text: Fonts are now bundled with the app, so that it can be used offline, and no longer depends on Bunny Fonts. A step towards making Papra fully air-gapped.

author: CorentinTh
text: Fixed OCR extraction for images whose rotation is stored in EXIF metadata.

author: CorentinTh
text: Silenced the content extraction warning about DPI.

author: CorentinTh
text: API breaking change: The route to trash a document `DELETE /api/organizations/:organizationId/documents/:documentId` now returns a 204 No Content status code instead of `{ success: true }` JSON body.

author: CorentinTh
text: Stack the alert dialog buttons vertically to avoid line breaks in long button labels on small screens.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added multi-lang support. Currently, the supported languages are English, French, German, and Spanish. You can now switch between these languages in the app settings, it automatically detects your device's language, and you can also set a preferred language.

author: CorentinTh
text: Fixed select and multi-select custom properties to display option names correctly (previously displayed as JSON).

author: CorentinTh
text: Format date according to the user's locale in the mobile app.

author: CorentinTh
text: Automatically load more documents as you scroll through the document list and search results, instead of showing only the first 20.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added app version and commit short hash in the app settings screen.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added a pull-to-refresh to the document details screen.

author: CorentinTh
text: Manage document tags from the document details or the document list.

author: bartdenhoed
text: Fixed missing refresh of the updatedAt db attribute.

author: CorentinTh
text: Removed the default value for the intake email webhook validation secret to prevent ingestion of documents from untrusted sources when no secret is provided. Users must now explicitly set a secret using `INTAKE_EMAILS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`. Thanks to [白墨](https://github.com/5255fgh) for the responsible disclosure of this issue.

author: CorentinTh
text: Security fix: Prevent custom OAuth providers from creating new accounts when registration is disabled, while allowing existing users to sign in. Thanks to [白墨](https://github.com/5255fgh) for the responsible disclosure of this issue.

author: jakubM817
text: Add Slovak (sk) translation for the app.

author: CorentinTh
text: Fully disabled AI credit accounting by default for self-hosted instances to silence "Failed to register AI credit usage" logs.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added an API endpoint to reprocess existing documents `POST /api/organizations/:organizationId/documents/:documentId/reprocess`. This endpoint allows re-running content extraction + auto tagging and tagging rules on existing documents.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added a button to reprocess a document in the documents content tab.

author: CorentinTh
text: Fixed document action menus wrapping longer translations by allowing the menu to expand.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added optional storage key synchronization so document renames are reflected in the underlying storage. Enable it with `DOCUMENT_STORAGE_KEY_SYNC_ENABLED=true` when using pattern-based storage keys.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added `document.date` and `document.createdAt` to storage key patterns, so you can organize files by document date or creation date. Documents without a date use `no-date` (and can be configured with the `default` transformer).

author: CorentinTh
text: Add support for `{{organization.name}}` in document storage key patterns to organize files into folders named after your organizations.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added Hungarian translation

author: CorentinTh
text: You can now configure Docling OCR languages and other conversion options with `DOCLING_OPTIONS`, using a JSON object such as `{"ocr_lang":["en","fr"]}`.

author: CorentinTh
text: Fix an issue that prevented reinviting users who left or were removed from an organisation.

author: CorentinTh
text: Added an option to restrict registration to specific email domains using `AUTH_ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS`. Forbidden domains still take precedence.
